description: Aider-polyglot style (Python, two modules), built for the repair round: a template engine with dotted-path lookup, nested conditionals, escapes and malformed-template errors. The natural first implementation substitutes tags with repeated str.replace or re.sub plus recursion and so expands a substituted value that itself contains {{ ... }}, and it tends to treat falsy values such as 0 or False as missing or empty; the tests catch both, so the post-turn verifier's second round has to fix them.
